preconditions.description: The number of videos n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The size of the hard disk m is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= m for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each video size a_i is between 1 and m inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum time required to watch all n videos given the hard disk size m and video sizes a.
